title: DepKeeper - Python Dependency Updater
description: A CLI that upgrades requirements.txt without crossing a major version boundary. It computes a safe target for each requirement, cross-checks them against each other, then rewrites the file in place, keeping the upper bounds and exclusions you wrote. Deliberately not a resolver and not a lock file. On PyPI under Apache 2.0, for Python 3.8 to 3.12.

title: Hallownest Codex - Hollow Knight Analyzer
description: A Streamlit app that reads Hollow Knight save files. It decrypts the .dat format, scores progress against the 112% completion target, plots what is still missing on an interactive map, suggests charm loadouts, and exports the result as a shareable report.
